pairs.difference: A (umbrella): the lace trim is packed with small hard eyelet holes, and every rib has a doubled, embossed edge. The canopy rim carries a dark band, and outline darkness (-0.13) falls below the real range. B (fan): long, clean pleat lines with a single crisp outer contour and a quiet wave background, all within the real ranges.
pairs.fix: Simplify the lace trim to a soft scalloped white band with a few large, gently shaded holes. Draw the ribs as smooth rounded tubes with no ridge lines, and let the canopy edge soften where it turns away into shadow.

pairs.difference: A (suitcase): each sticker has a heavy dark ring around it and a doubled die-cut border. The case silhouette has a continuous dark rim, and outline darkness (0.128) is above the real range. B (trunk): the straps and corner caps have thin, precise seams. The stone floor is busy, but the edges stay within range.
pairs.fix: Paint the stickers as flat printed decals with a thin light edge and no dark ring around them. Let the suitcase's outer edge be defined by the color change against the background, not by a darker rim.

pairs.difference: A (target and teddy): the wooden frame posts and shelf are full of grain lines, and every target ring has a hard dark contour. Background edge density (0.058) is high, and the frame lines compete with the target for sharpness. B (envelope): the village inside the photo is dense, but the envelope flaps have clean single seams over a calm ring background.
pairs.fix: Make the wooden frame and shelf smooth painted planks with no grain lines and softer edges. Keep the crisp edges on the target face and the arrow only.

pairs.difference: B (sneakers): the mesh panels are a fine grid of tiny edges, and the laces cross in many hard lines. A hard horizon line cuts behind the shoes. Subject edge density (0.227) is at the very top of the real range, and outline darkness (-0.1) is below it. A (hatbox): a few clean stripe seams, a crisp lid rim and a rope handle, with soft falloff into the shadow.
pairs.fix: Replace the mesh texture with smooth, softly shaded panels. Use fewer, thicker rounded laces. Blend the floor-to-wall meeting into a soft gradient instead of a sharp line.

pairs.difference: B (guitar): a heavy dark contour runs around the whole body, and the frets, strings and pickups are many thin hard lines. The stage truss and light beams add hard background edges. Outline darkness (0.163) is above the real range and subject density (0.242) is near the top. A (piano): there is wood grain and wallpaper pattern, but the piano's outer edge is defined by value change rather than a drawn rim.
pairs.fix: Remove the dark outline around the guitar body and let its red edge meet the background directly. Simplify the strings and frets to a few soft lines. Replace the metal truss with a soft blurred backdrop.

pairs.difference: A (cake stand): a hard, dark, ruler-straight line marks where the table meets the wall, and the tablecloth is covered in fine wrinkle-texture edges. The stand itself has thin, weak edges, so subject density (0.085) is below the real range and the strongest edge is in the background. B (fountain): the stone tiers and tile seams are clear and evenly weighted, and the water arcs have crisp edges.
pairs.fix: Make the tablecloth a smooth soft surface with no fine wrinkles, and blend the back edge of the table into the wall. Give the stand's rims and the pastries crisper, brighter edges so they are the sharpest thing on the card.

pairs.difference: A (teacup): the gold rim and saucer edge are drawn as doubled thin lines, and the steam is a soft, lost-edge wisp. The plain pink gradient background has almost no edges. Outline darkness (-0.125) is below the real range. B (vending machine): clean panel seams, a crisp door frame, and small droplet speckles on the glass, all within range.
pairs.fix: Give the cup and saucer one confident rounded rim edge instead of thin double lines. Add a simple patterned backdrop such as soft rays or a wide stripe pattern.

pairs.difference: A (pocket watch): every numeral has a heavy dark contour, and the chain links are a dense run of hard edges. The case has a thick dark rim. Subject density (0.216) and outline darkness (0.149) are both above the real range. B (ring box): soft, rounded box edges and a single clean coin rim. Its outline darkness is also slightly high, but the box is far less busy.
pairs.fix: Paint the numerals as flat dark-blue print without raised edges. Show the chain as a few large, smoothly shaded links. Soften the case rim so it reads as polished gold, not an outlined border.

pairs.difference: A (top hat): one smooth contour around the crown and brim, a clean band seam, and few internal edges. B (graduation cap): a crisp board edge, a clean button and cord, and tassel strands as the only fine detail. Both sit inside the real ranges and show similar edge weight.

A (fan): every pleat fold and rib has a doubled, embossed edge, and the guard sticks are stacked hard lines. Outline darkness (-0.115) is below the real range. B (scarf): a single smooth contour, soft fabric folds, and a crisp ring around the badge as the focus.
pairs.fix: Draw the pleats as soft, broad light-and-shadow bands with no ridge lines on each fold. Use fewer, thicker wooden ribs with rounded edges.

pairs.difference: A (rocking chair): a dark contour wraps the armrests, runners and back posts, and the floorboards and backrest carry wood-grain lines. Edge strength is spread evenly over chair and floor. B (inkwell and quill): the feather barbs are soft, the glass has crisp highlight edges at the focus, and the table seams are light.
pairs.fix: Remove the dark rim around the chair parts and let the wood shapes separate by light and shadow. Make the floor smooth planks with no grain lines, softer than the chair.

pairs.difference: A (bus): the road is a field of speckled noise edges, and the buildings, clouds and window frames all carry similarly hard edges. The bus is cropped, and nothing marks a sharpest focus. B (neon ice cream): the soft glow around the sign is part of the neon design, and the cone's waffle grid is crisp and centered.
pairs.fix: Make the road a smooth soft-shaded surface with no grain speckle. Blur and simplify the background buildings so the bus front and headlights hold the only crisp edges.

pattern: Generated cards spread hard edges evenly across the image instead of saving the sharpest edges for the focal object. Recurring tells: dark rims traced around silhouettes and stickers or decals; doubled, embossed ridge lines on ribs and rims; dense micro-detail such as mesh, chains, numerals and lace eyelets; and textured backgrounds (wood grain, wrinkles, road speckle, ruler-straight horizon lines) as sharp as the hero. Real cards keep one clean value-defined silhouette, few thin seams, and backgrounds that stay soft.
